title: ゆりかごのうた (Yurikago no Uta — Cradle Song)
description: A canary sings a cradle song as a yellow moon descends into dreams, apple blossoms fall over the cradle, and a small mouse gently rocks the rope. Four gentle verses of dreamy imagery — moon, flowers, a woodland creature — that carry a child to sleep. Published 1921. Lyrics: 北原白秋 (Kitahara Hakushu, d.1942), music: 草川信 (Kusakawa Shin, d.1948). Both copyrights expired under Japan's 50-year rule (~1992/1998), before the 2018 extension.
